close_reason: Advance cursor on rejected articles too; prevent infinite loop on permanently-invalid content
description: Trigger: import/suck_pull.rs cursor advances only when summary.fetched > fetched_before. If every article in a batch returns IngestResult::Rejected (e.g. all fail mandatory header validation or group filter), fetched never increments and the cursor is not saved. Bad behavior: on the next run the same batch is fetched and rejected again indefinitely. A single permanently-invalid article at the current cursor position causes suck_pull to loop forever without making progress.
title: suck_pull cursor stuck in infinite rejection loop for permanently-invalid articles
